# Atomic Concepts

<details markdown="block">
  <summary>Table of contents</summary>
1. TOC
{:toc}
</details>

The freestanding semantic units of Grace Commons — each fully specifiable without naming another atom. Atoms are stored flat (`library/atoms/<name>.md`); their classification is not a folder but a set of **lenses** over the Intent Graph. Overlays (regulated · security · standards) are read off the composition graph and **report usage, not essence** — a standard shows as *HIPAA via audit-trail*, an uncomposed atom as *composed by: (none yet)*, never a bare boolean. **Domain** is the one intrinsic axis: an optional, EOS-gated tag, default absent. The design and its rationale are in [the taxonomy note](./_TAXONOMY.md).

## Lens — security

An overlay, not a domain: an atom carries it iff it derives an identity / access / crypto-family standard (NIST 800-63/53/207, OWASP ASVS, SCIM, FIPS 180-4). Cross-cutting and multi-valued — an atom can hold it alongside any domain.

## Lens — by domain

The one intrinsic axis. A domain earns a tag only when stripping it fails to leave a freestanding, domain-neutral primitive (the EOS test); default absent. The system is correct with zero domain tags — domain is additive, never load-bearing.

- **healthcare**: [Medication Order](./medication-order.idd)
